content.short: Jesus 2 is an innovative NFT animation project on Cardano created by acclaimed artist Jesse Moynihan.
content.description: Jesus 2 is a Web3-native animation project on the Cardano blockchain, led by acclaimed artist Jesse Moynihan, known for his work on Adventure Time. The project utilizes NFT sales to directly fund the creation of an original animated series, offering a decentralized alternative to traditional media production. Holders of Jesus 2 NFTs gain exclusive access to the 'Secret Hideout' community area, behind-the-scenes content, and early premieres of new episodes. By bridging the gap between independent animation and blockchain tech, Jesus 2 empowers creators and their audiences alike.
content.meta: Jesus 2 is a Cardano NFT animation project by Jesse Moynihan for decentralized media. Explore Jesus 2 now on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
